title: Graph Beta: authenticated current-graph query
description: Objective: make the existing graph.get query reachable through the production daemon HTTP/MCP path without copying projection logic. Deliverable: a bounded query handler/port branch that authenticates the session, derives the project/principal from the authenticated request context, calls task-dd4ffa0c40834c59892f957fbf61fb23's public durable current-active reader, and returns its immutable snapshot plus revision/epoch/content provenance. Hard dependency: task-dd4ffa0c40834c59892f957fbf61fb23 with the GraphRevisionContent authority decision resolved. NOT in scope: graph mutations, registry command decisions, new runtime kinds, Foundation attempt dispatch or UI. Consumer/final hardening: task-efc2ef6330074b4d9893809f7425c95f. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: The frozen graph.get query kind is handled by the real production HTTP/MCP authentication and query dispatch path; project and principal come from the authenticated context and no payload/query field can select a different project or active revision.

The handler calls task-dd4ffa0c40834c59892f957fbf61fb23's public reader and returns the exact deeply frozen current snapshot, revision identity, graphEpoch, full graphContentHash provenance and separately named structural snapshot identity without equating the two.

No active graph, malformed/noncanonical history, multiple active revisions, receipt/decision mismatch or unreadable store state preserves the reader's exact stable code/layer and returns UNKNOWN/no snapshot authority.

Real Authenticator + SqliteEventStore tests cover unauthenticated/capability/project spoofing before reader invocation, every reader refusal with exact code/layer, nonzero hostile cases, and one accepted production event-to-MCP control; query reads leave event/decision counts unchanged.
Daemon typecheck and test gates execute with nonzero Test Files/Tests counts, public runtime bridges load under plain Node, and production files remain focused under the per-file cap.
taskRails: Consume the durable projection; do not copy its fold or trust scanned event payloads directly.
Use only existing graph.get vocabulary and real HTTP/MCP authentication; no new schema/kind, no command-decision write and no caller-selected authority.
Wait for dec-64b2391cb80f4c0cbb6e88353017cc65; never label scheduler graphIdentity as graphContentHash. TDD and explicit-path discipline apply.
